import re

# Read behavioral_signals.rs to verify implementation
with open('/home/coding/AgentScribe/src/enrichment/behavioral_signals.rs', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Check ConfigWriteEvent struct
config_write_event = re.search(r'pub struct ConfigWriteEvent \{([^}]+)\}', content, re.DOTALL)
print("ConfigWriteEvent struct:")
if config_write_event:
    print(config_write_event.group(1))
print()

# Check config_writes field
config_writes_field = re.search(r'pub config_writes: Vec<ConfigWriteEvent>', content)
print(f"✓ config_writes field in BehavioralSignals: {bool(config_writes_field)}")
print()

# Check Write tool detection
write_detection = re.search(r'if event\.tool\.as_deref\(\) == Some\("Write"\)', content)
print(f"✓ Write tool detection: {bool(write_detection)}")
print()

# Check Edit tool detection  
edit_detection = re.search(r'if event\.tool\.as_deref\(\) == Some\("Edit"\)', content)
print(f"✓ Edit tool detection: {bool(edit_detection)}")
print()

# Check config_writes population
config_writes_push = re.findall(r'config_writes\.push\(ConfigWriteEvent', content)
print(f"✓ config_writes populated {len(config_writes_push)} times")
print()

# Check DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILE_PATTERNS
default_patterns = re.search(r'DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILE_PATTERNS.*?=&\[(.*?)\]', content, re.DOTALL)
print("Default config patterns:")
if default_patterns:
    patterns = default_patterns.group(1)
    for pattern in patterns.strip().split('\n'):
        pattern = pattern.strip().strip('"').strip(',')
        if pattern:
            print(f"  - {pattern}")
print()

# Check tests
test_config_writes = re.findall(r'fn test_\w+.*config.*write', content, re.IGNORECASE)
print(f"✓ Config write tests: {len(test_config_writes)}")
for test in test_config_writes:
    print(f"  - {test}")

EOF
